WITH side_counts AS (
  SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
), above_average AS (
  SELECT risk_margin_count
  FROM side_counts
  WHERE risk_margin_count > (SELECT AVG(risk_margin_count) FROM side_counts)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(risk_margin_count), 0) AS sum_of_counts,
       AVG(risk_margin_count - (SELECT AVG(risk_margin_count) FROM side_counts)) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: The average count is the arithmetic mean across sides that have at least one matched risk/margin record; sides with zero records are absent from the grouped counts.
